German Studies, Allen, and West Houses Host Festive Oktoberfest Celebration at The Cube

A large crowd of students and faculty turned out to enjoy the beautiful autumn weather, listen to great music, play traditional Oktoberfest inspired games, and get a break from midterm seriousness with inflatable pretzels at the photo wall. The annual event provided a wonderful, relaxed space for our campus community to connect, unwind, and practice their German conversation skills.

A highlight for the guests was a delicious spread of German inspired foods that included hearty brats, crispy schnitzel, tangy sauerkraut and traditional red cabbage, followed up with Black Forest and sweet apple cake.

Vielen Dank / Thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us, and a special thanks to Allen House and West House for sponsoring and hosting this successful community tradition!
